# TLV Parking

> Tel Aviv-Yafo parking lots with the estimated price for a specific time window (Shabbat/holiday tariffs, TLV-resident discounts and special deals applied), live occupancy, and map links. Read-only, no auth.

Coverage: priced lots from Ahuzot HaHof (municipal, 88), Central Park, Green Parking, Azrieli, Dizengoff Center and Sarona; plus about 190 more public lots with no published price (the city's license registry and OpenStreetMap), returned with `price_ils: null` and ranked last.
Open municipal lots the city lists as free come back with `price_ils: 0` and `price_basis: "municipal_data_unverified"`: say it is unverified and to check the sign.
Central Park lots have a cheaper in-app price: `gate_price_ils` and `app_price_ils`; pass `apps=centralpark` to rank by it.
Prices are estimates from the operator's published tariff; the sign at the gate prevails. Times are Asia/Jerusalem.
Searches near a point also return `street`: blue-white curbside parking there (zone, area center/city, `price_ils` for the stay at the city's rates, `who` = the stay's price and hourly rate for each kind of driver: `own_zone` permit (free), `other_zone` permit (any Tel Aviv resident: 2 free hours a day, then 30% off), `visitor`; `chance_pct` = a rough estimate of finding a spot from time of day and nearby lots' live occupancy, not live street data). Pass `zone` (the user's residential permit zone) for permit pricing.

## MCP

- Endpoint: `/mcp` (streamable HTTP, stateless, no sign-in). Tools: `search_parking`, `get_lot_details`.

## REST

- [OpenAPI spec](/openapi.json)
- `GET /api/search?near=Dizengoff%20Center&start=2026-10-10T14:00&duration=180`: lots ranked by price. Optional: `lat`,`lng` instead of `near`; `weekday=sat&time=14:00` instead of `start`; `max_walk` (m, default 800); `resident=1`; `zone` (permit zone, 1-13); `apps=pango,cello,centralpark`; `transit=1`; `ev=1`, `covered=1`, `accessible=1` (only lots known to have it; null = unknown); `height=2.1` (car height in m; drops only lots with a lower published limit); `sort=distance`; `limit`; `sub=night|full|weekdays|motorcycle|reserved` for monthly passes (only lots selling that pass, ranked by pass price; every result also lists its `subscriptions`; `source: city` prices may be out of date).
- `GET /api/lots/{id}?start=...&duration=...`: one lot with full tariff (original Hebrew text), hours, offers, live status and Waze/Google Maps links.
- `GET /api/places?q=דיזנגוף 50`: place/address to coordinates (Hebrew works best for streets).
- `GET /api/street?lat=32.0805&lng=34.7815`: the street nearest the point and the blue-white parking zones along it, per side (`odd`/`even`: `[{zone, from, to}]` house numbers). Long streets cross zones; border streets (e.g. Ibn Gabirol) have a different zone on each side. 404 outside Tel Aviv-Yafo's zones.

Every result has a `map_url` that opens the lot on the map for the same time window.
